entities.summary: Oburu Ng'ong'a Oginga is a Kenyan politician who has served as senator for Siaya County 8th August 2022. He previously served the East African Legislative Assembly from 2017 to 2022. He is the former assistant minister for finance in the 2008 Grand Coalition government and a former Member of the Kenyan Parliament.
